items.title: MIT develops framework for assessing economics of fusion
items.summary: A study by Massachusetts Institute of Technology researchers proposes a framework for understanding what is needed to make fusion energy commercially viable in the marketplace. The method considers the physical inputs needed to sustain controlled fusion energy production, as well as the cost of building power plants that can compete in energy markets.
